translation: It took place in the posad of Serock on 18 January 1890 at 10 AM. Personally appeared Izrael Ioskowicz, feldsher, 55, and Jankel Borensztejn, szkolnik, 40, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday of the current year at 8 AM in posad Serock died Chana [unclear surname], nine months of age, daughter of Lejba and Łaja née [unclear: Konkol]. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Chana [surname, genitive] this act was signed by us and the witnesses. Civil registrar [signature].
